experiment.name: form4_opportunistic_purchase_stage_a_v1
experiment.reason: The 2023-2024 development period is used once to decide whether the insider-information sleeve merits exact SEC clocks and permanent-security engineering. No 2025 Form 4 event return may be computed by this protocol.

candidate_accessions.limitation: SEC bulk flattened as-filed data; candidate census protocol followed candidate counts and therefore is not a valid preregistration.

price_provider.name: Yahoo Finance chart API
price_provider.adjustment: vendor adjusted close and derived adjusted open
price_provider.limitation: Retrospectively adjusted current-ticker histories are not a permanent-security master and do not contain complete delisting payoff lineage.

candidate_selection.owner_classification_clock: January 1 label built only from trades in the prior three complete calendar years whose filing-date EOD proxy was already public by that January 1
candidate_selection.same_ticker_entry_session_policy: collapse accession rows and sum disclosed direct purchase value
candidate_selection.overlapping_signal_policy: within each event class, retain the earliest entry and ignore later same-ticker signals whose entry is on or before the retained event exit
candidate_selection.cross_class_same_ticker_entry_policy: exclude both classes before any outcome lookup
candidate_selection.signal_label_limitation: Form 4 code P includes exchange and private purchases.

clock_and_execution.quarantine_rule: quarantine the first observed SPY regular session whose calendar date is strictly after filing_date
clock_and_execution.entry_rule: enter at the next observed SPY regular-session open after the quarantined session, i.e. the second SPY open strictly after filing_date
clock_and_execution.exit_rule: exit at the SPY regular-session open 20 sessions after entry
clock_and_execution.benchmark_calendar: SPY observed adjusted-open sessions; no fabricated or forward-filled sessions
clock_and_execution.clock_claim: conservative filing-date proxy only; no historical first-public timestamp claim
clock_and_execution.missing_clock_or_price_policy: exclude and report; fail the coverage gate

universe.nominal_price_filter_reason: Yahoo historical Close is retrospectively split-adjusted, so a nominal historical price cutoff could use future corporate actions; Stage A relies on the dollar-volume screen instead

risk_adjustment.beta_window_end_rule: use the 252 matched daily returns ending at the placebo start session, so beta estimation does not consume any return inside the pre-event placebo interval

estimands.pre_event_placebo: 20-session beta-hedged adjusted-open return ending at the last observed SPY open strictly before filing_date; gross only
estimands.aggregation: equal weight within entry session and equal weight across ordered entry sessions

inference.inference_unit: HAC uses actual SPY session-index distance; circular MBB uses ordered nonempty entry-date observations as a non-decision sensitivity
inference.bootstrap_null: center ordered entry-session returns before circular all-start block resampling
inference.mechanism_control: paired common-entry-date opportunistic net mean minus routine net mean greater than zero
inference.interpretation: Multiplying by 124 is a strict screening hurdle across at least 124 disclosed trials; because 124 is a lower bound rather than a complete family size, it is not a Bonferroni FWER claim. The circular MBB is reported as a non-decision sensitivity because its 20-row blocks are observation blocks rather than SPY-session blocks.

sample.coverage_denominator: unique frozen schedule_id values after overlap and cross-class conflict suppression; low-ADV eligibility exclusions count as path-complete; benchmark clock failures are measured separately against selected opportunistic candidate rows

efficacy.pre_event_placebo_falsification: fail only when mean is positive and raw one-sided HAC p is less than or equal to 0.05; non-rejection does not prove no pre-trend

concentration.contribution_formula: for each opportunistic event, take the absolute value of net_return divided by event_count_on_entry_date and number_of_opportunistic_entry_dates; sum these gross absolute contributions by ticker and divide by the total

stop_gates.decision: Any primary, stress, placebo, coverage, or concentration failure retires this Stage A proxy without threshold, horizon, class, liquidity, beta, or weighting repair. Passing only authorizes exact-clock and permanent-security Stage B work.
